scope: Offline original Thumb instructions in synthetic host memory; no service, resource allocation, target process, camera, pixel processing or codec executes.
address_model: Retained runtime addresses = CP file offsets +0x108000; odd pointers select Thumb.

observed.descriptor_fields: Backing helper reads handle at+4 and logical offset at+8. Descriptor type+0 is not consulted by this helper; higher layers may use it.
observed.query_result_table: Count u16 at+0; up to8 interpreted slots stride16: u64 base at+8+16*i, u32 length at+0x10+16*i. Resolver scans8 lengths, not count.
observed.response_table: Response command/status at+0/+2, sequence u16+6, segment count u16+8; segment base+0x18+16*i,length+0x20+16*i.
observed.outer_vs_nested: JPEG45b62c resolves outer metadata descriptor, checks SSYC, walks ETRY type0, decodes a second pixel unit/handle/offset triple from payload+0/+4/+0x18 into record+4/+8/+0xc. Pixel geometry sourcepayload+0x2e/+0x30 ->record+0x18/+0x1a.
observed.metadata_release: 45b62c releases outer handle after parsing. aecc5c releases query handle before returning physical scalar. Neither timing establishes live buffer ownership/lifetime.
observed.JPEG_pixel_callsite: Initializer0xaf1d9e copies object+0x88/+0x8c/+0x90 (decoded image triple) totemp;0xaf1db4 calls aecc5c; stores physical result64bits at object+0xd8.

comparison_to_MLUT_ring.established: Earlier trace_mlut_encoder_link.py follows resource-service pool token/base/current ->context+0x1e0 ->pixel port+0x160. This mapper establishes how an independently supplied nested pixel handle+offset resolves to a backing address.
comparison_to_MLUT_ring.unresolved: No source-bound equality yet between the live nested pixel handle/segments and the MLUT ring token/base/current, and no port direction or saved-frame ownership proof.

limits: Resolving one logical offset returns one physical point; capacity summed across segments does not prove a contiguous extent.
